note: This slice lands .githooks pre-commit gate scripts (net-new gates + small edits to existing gates) and repairs 31 never-run broken tests. Every line here is gate orchestration: it shells out to git, docker, and ruff, parses staged diffs, and emits Rule-F messages. There is no compute hot-path Python: the gates are dominated by subprocess and git I/O, not CPU. python_lines_remaining=0 means zero compute-Python lines that would warrant a native (C++/Go/Rust) rewrite, which is correct for I/O-bound pre-commit gates.

baseline.workload: a single pre-commit run shells out to git diff + docker + ruff; the Python is glue, not compute
